comment: MoviPass parking application email templates. Load with: php artisan kanvas:import-email-templates {app_id} database/data/movipass_parking_email_templates.json — then kanvas:movipass-setup-parking-application-rules {app_id} --receiver={id} points the parking receiver at them.
